titolo: OpenAI's Dean Ball warns of societal impact as AI capabilities grow
descr: Dean Ball, OpenAI’s head of strategic futures, outlines how more capable AI could reshape society and how institutions might stay in human hands.
paragrafi: OpenAI released a new analysis called The Silent Consensus.
Dean Ball, head of strategic futures at OpenAI, wrote the piece.
"More capable AI will reshape society," he said.
The analysis looks at how advancing AI could change social structures and how people can retain control of institutions.
It appears while the AI model market expands, free chat models like Kimi K3 rank highest and Gemini 4 Carbon leads paid rankings.
perche: The paper signals that users should consider governance when picking AI tools. Free models such as Kimi K3 let users run software locally, while paid options like Gemini 4 Carbon may offer more capability but keep control with providers.
